question_fa: شهرهای outlier از نظر نرخ افسردگی رو با z-score بده.
sql: WITH cr AS (SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n, 100.0*SUM(depression_flag)/COUNT(*) AS rate FROM student_depression WHERE city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*)>=500), st AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS m, AVG(rate*rate)-AVG(rate)*AVG(rate) AS v FROM cr) SELECT city,n,ROUND(rate,2) AS depression_rate_pct, ROUND((rate-m)/SQRT(v),2) AS z_score FROM cr CROSS JOIN st WHERE v>0 ORDER BY z_score DESC LIMIT 15;

question_fa: کیفیت داده نمای یکپارچه را به تفکیک منبع از نظر کامل بودن سن، جنسیت، خواب و شاخص درمان بررسی کن.
sql: SELECT source_name, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN age IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS age_completeness_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gender IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS gender_completeness_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sleep_hours IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS sleep_completeness_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN treatment_flag IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS treatment_completeness_pct FROM vw_unified_individual_mental_health GROUP BY source_name ORDER BY total DESC;

question_fa: در دیتاست دانشجویان افسردگی، gender را از نظر نرخ افسردگی و فشار تحصیلی رتبه‌بندی کن.
sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS total, 100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*) AS depression_rate_pct, AVG(academic_pressure) AS avg_academic_pressure, AVG(cgpa_10) AS avg_cgpa FROM student_depression GROUP BY gender) SELECT gender, total, ROUND(depression_rate_pct, 2) AS depression_rate_pct, ROUND(avg_academic_pressure, 2) AS avg_academic_pressure, ROUND(avg_cgpa, 2) AS avg_cgpa_10, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY depression_rate_pct DESC) AS rank_by_depression_rate FROM grouped ORDER BY rank_by_depression_rate;

question_fa: تو survey شرکت‌ها چند نفر treatment گرفتن؟
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_treatment_yes FROM workplace_mental_health_survey WHERE treatment = 1;

question_fa: تعداد دانشجویان دارای شغل پاره‌وقت و بدون شغل پاره‌وقت چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT part_time_job, COUNT(*) AS count FROM student_habits_performance GROUP BY part_time_job ORDER BY count DESC;

question_fa: توزیع سابقه خانوادگی بیماری روانی در دانشجویان افسردگی را نشان بده.
sql: SELECT family_history_mental_illness, COUNT(*) AS count FROM student_depression GROUP BY family_history_mental_illness ORDER BY count DESC;

question_fa: داشبورد عملکرد دانشجویان: چهارک‌های عملکرد را از نظر خواب، مطالعه، شبکه اجتماعی و سلامت روان مقایسه کن.
sql: WITH q AS (SELECT *, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY exam_score) AS exam_quartile FROM student_habits_performance), agg AS (SELECT exam_quartile, COUNT(*) AS total, AVG(exam_score) AS avg_exam, AVG(study_hours_per_day) AS avg_study_hours, AVG(social_media_hours) AS avg_social_media, AVG(sleep_hours) AS avg_sleep, AVG(mental_health_rating) AS avg_mental_health, AVG(attendance_percentage) AS avg_attendance FROM q GROUP BY exam_quartile) SELECT exam_quartile, total, ROUND(avg_exam, 2) AS avg_exam, ROUND(avg_study_hours, 2) AS avg_study_hours, ROUND(avg_social_media, 2) AS avg_social_media, ROUND(avg_sleep, 2) AS avg_sleep, ROUND(avg_mental_health, 2) AS avg_mental_health, ROUND(avg_attendance, 2) AS avg_attendance FROM agg ORDER BY exam_quartile;

question_fa: کشورهایی که در آخرین سال، بیشترین شیوع اضطراب را دارند کدام‌اند؟
sql: SELECT country_name, year, ROUND(prevalence_pct, 3) AS anxiety_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE disorder = 'anxiety' AND is_country_like = 1 AND year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long) ORDER BY prevalence_pct DESC LIMIT 15;

question_fa: برای India، آخرین مقدار هر اختلال، رتبه جهانی آن و فاصله از میانگین جهانی را بساز.
sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT * FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE is_country_like = 1 AND year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long)), global_avg AS (SELECT disorder, AVG(prevalence_pct) AS avg_prevalence FROM latest GROUP BY disorder), ranked AS (SELECT disorder, country_name, prevalence_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY disorder ORDER BY prevalence_pct DESC) AS global_rank FROM latest) SELECT r.disorder, ROUND(r.prevalence_pct, 3) AS country_prevalence_pct, r.global_rank, ROUND(g.avg_prevalence, 3) AS global_avg_prevalence_pct, ROUND(r.prevalence_pct - g.avg_prevalence, 3) AS gap_from_global_avg FROM ranked r JOIN global_avg g ON g.disorder = r.disorder WHERE r.country_name = 'India' ORDER BY country_prevalence_pct DESC;

question_fa: ریموت و غیرریموت از نظر treatment چه تفاوتی دارن؟
sql: SELECT remote_work AS group_value, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(100.0*SUM(treatment)/COUNT(*),2) AS treatment_rate_pct FROM workplace_mental_health_survey WHERE remote_work IS NOT NULL GROUP BY remote_work  ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 15;

question_fa: داشبورد شکاف بهره‌وری دیتاست عمومی بر اساس روزهای فعالیت فیزیکی را بساز.
sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(productivity_score) AS overall_productivity, AVG(depression_score) AS overall_depression FROM mental_health_general), grouped AS (SELECT physical_activity_days, COUNT(*) AS total, AVG(productivity_score) AS avg_productivity, AVG(depression_score) AS avg_depression, AVG(anxiety_score) AS avg_anxiety, SUM(CASE WHEN mental_health_risk='High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_risk_count FROM mental_health_general GROUP BY physical_activity_days) SELECT physical_activity_days, total, ROUND(avg_productivity, 2) AS avg_productivity, ROUND(avg_productivity - overall_productivity, 2) AS productivity_gap, ROUND(avg_depression, 2) AS avg_depression, ROUND(avg_depression - overall_depression, 2) AS depression_gap, ROUND(avg_anxiety, 2) AS avg_anxiety, ROUND(100.0 * high_risk_count / total, 2) AS high_risk_rate_pct FROM grouped CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY productivity_gap ASC;

question_fa: داشبورد اولویت مداخله دانشجویان افسردگی بر اساس سابقه خانوادگی را بساز.
sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT family_history_mental_illness, COUNT(*) AS total, 100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*) AS depression_rate_pct, 100.0 * SUM(suicidal_thoughts) / COUNT(*) AS suicidal_rate_pct, AVG(academic_pressure) AS avg_academic_pressure, AVG(cgpa_10) AS avg_cgpa FROM student_depression GROUP BY family_history_mental_illness), scored AS (SELECT *, depression_rate_pct * 0.40 + suicidal_rate_pct * 0.35 + avg_academic_pressure * 10 * 0.25 AS intervention_priority_score FROM grouped) SELECT family_history_mental_illness, total, ROUND(depression_rate_pct, 2) AS depression_rate_pct, ROUND(suicidal_rate_pct, 2) AS suicidal_rate_pct, ROUND(avg_academic_pressure, 2) AS avg_academic_pressure, ROUND(avg_cgpa, 2) AS avg_cgpa_10, ROUND(intervention_priority_score, 2) AS intervention_priority_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY intervention_priority_score DESC) AS priority_rank FROM scored ORDER BY priority_rank;

question_fa: برای Sweden، آخرین مقدار هر اختلال، رتبه جهانی و فاصله از میانگین جهانی را بساز.
sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT * FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE is_country_like = 1 AND year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long)), global_avg AS (SELECT disorder, AVG(prevalence_pct) AS avg_prevalence FROM latest GROUP BY disorder), ranked AS (SELECT disorder, country_name, prevalence_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY disorder ORDER BY prevalence_pct DESC) AS global_rank FROM latest) SELECT r.disorder, ROUND(r.prevalence_pct, 3) AS country_prevalence_pct, r.global_rank, ROUND(g.avg_prevalence, 3) AS global_avg_prevalence_pct, ROUND(r.prevalence_pct - g.avg_prevalence, 3) AS gap_from_global_avg FROM ranked r JOIN global_avg g ON g.disorder = r.disorder WHERE r.country_name = 'Sweden' ORDER BY country_prevalence_pct DESC;

question_fa: کیفیت اینترنت بچه‌ها چه توزیعی داره؟
sql: SELECT internet_quality, COUNT(*) AS n_students FROM student_habits_performance GROUP BY internet_quality ORDER BY n_students DESC;

question_fa: توزیع جنسیت در دیتاست دانشجویان افسردگی را نشان بده.
sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS count FROM student_depression GROUP BY gender ORDER BY count DESC;

question_fa: آخرین سال، ده کشور با بیشترین اضطراب رو نشون بده.
sql: SELECT country_name, ROUND(prevalence_pct,4) AS anxiety_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE disorder='anxiety' AND year=(SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long) ORDER BY prevalence_pct DESC LIMIT 10;

question_fa: در دانشجویان عادت‌ها، شاخص تعادل سبک زندگی بساز و آن را با عملکرد مقایسه کن.
sql: WITH scored AS (SELECT *, (CASE WHEN sleep_hours BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN study_hours_per_day BETWEEN 2 AND 6 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN social_media_hours <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN exercise_frequency >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN diet_quality = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lifestyle_balance_score FROM student_habits_performance), grouped AS (SELECT lifestyle_balance_score, COUNT(*) AS total, AVG(exam_score) AS avg_exam, AVG(mental_health_rating) AS avg_mental_health, AVG(attendance_percentage) AS avg_attendance FROM scored GROUP BY lifestyle_balance_score) SELECT lifestyle_balance_score, total, ROUND(avg_exam, 2) AS avg_exam_score, ROUND(avg_mental_health, 2) AS avg_mental_health_rating, ROUND(avg_attendance, 2) AS avg_attendance_percentage FROM grouped ORDER BY lifestyle_balance_score;

question_fa: تعداد رکوردهای شیوع جهانی برای Iran چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE country_name = 'Iran';

question_fa: رابطه استفاده از شبکه اجتماعی و نمره امتحان را دسته‌بندی کن.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN social_media_hours < 2 THEN '<2h' WHEN social_media_hours < 4 THEN '2-4h' WHEN social_media_hours < 6 THEN '4-6h' ELSE '6h+' END AS social_media_bucket, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(AVG(exam_score), 2) AS avg_exam_score, ROUND(AVG(mental_health_rating), 2) AS avg_mental_health_rating FROM student_habits_performance GROUP BY social_media_bucket ORDER BY MIN(social_media_hours);

question_fa: میانگین نمره افسردگی در دیتاست عمومی چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(depression_score), 2) AS avg_depression_score FROM mental_health_general WHERE depression_score IS NOT NULL;

question_fa: درصد درمان‌جویی در محیط کار بر اساس امکان مراقبت سلامت روان چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT care_options, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(treatment) AS treatment_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(treatment) / COUNT(*), 2) AS treatment_rate_pct FROM workplace_mental_health_survey GROUP BY care_options ORDER BY treatment_rate_pct DESC;

question_fa: در دیتاست عادت‌های دانشجویی، part_time_job را با میانگین کل نمره امتحان مقایسه کن.
sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(exam_score) AS overall_avg_exam FROM student_habits_performance), grouped AS (SELECT part_time_job, COUNT(*) AS total, AVG(exam_score) AS avg_exam, AVG(mental_health_rating) AS avg_mental_health FROM student_habits_performance GROUP BY part_time_job) SELECT part_time_job, total, ROUND(avg_exam, 2) AS avg_exam_score, ROUND(overall_avg_exam, 2) AS overall_avg_exam, ROUND(avg_exam - overall_avg_exam, 2) AS exam_gap, ROUND(avg_mental_health, 2) AS avg_mental_health FROM grouped CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY exam_gap DESC;

question_fa: در هر اختلال، ۱۰ کشور با بیشترین افزایش از ۱۹۹۰ تا آخرین سال را نشان بده.
sql: WITH endpoints AS (SELECT disorder, country_name, MAX(CASE WHEN year = 1990 THEN prevalence_pct END) AS value_1990, MAX(CASE WHEN year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long) THEN prevalence_pct END) AS value_latest FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE is_country_like = 1 GROUP BY disorder, country_name), changes AS (SELECT disorder, country_name, value_1990, value_latest, value_latest - value_1990 AS change_pct_point FROM endpoints WHERE value_1990 IS NOT NULL AND value_latest IS NOT NULL), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY disorder ORDER BY change_pct_point DESC) AS rn FROM changes) SELECT disorder, country_name, ROUND(value_1990, 3) AS value_1990, ROUND(value_latest, 3) AS value_latest, ROUND(change_pct_point, 3) AS change_pct_point FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 10 ORDER BY disorder, change_pct_point DESC;

question_fa: میانگین سن دانشجوهای افسرده حدوداً چنده؟
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(age),2) AS mean_age_depressed_students FROM student_depression WHERE depression_flag = 1 AND age IS NOT NULL;

question_fa: در دیتاست عادت‌های دانشجویی، gender را با میانگین کل نمره امتحان مقایسه کن.
sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(exam_score) AS overall_avg_exam FROM student_habits_performance), grouped AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS total, AVG(exam_score) AS avg_exam, AVG(mental_health_rating) AS avg_mental_health FROM student_habits_performance GROUP BY gender) SELECT gender, total, ROUND(avg_exam, 2) AS avg_exam_score, ROUND(overall_avg_exam, 2) AS overall_avg_exam, ROUND(avg_exam - overall_avg_exam, 2) AS exam_gap, ROUND(avg_mental_health, 2) AS avg_mental_health FROM grouped CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY exam_gap DESC;

question_fa: ۱۰ کشور پرتکرار در نظرسنجی محیط کار کدام‌اند؟
sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS count FROM workplace_mental_health_survey WHERE country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10;

question_fa: جنسیت‌ها تو دیتاست افسردگی دانشجوها چه تعدادی دارن؟
sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS n_students FROM student_depression GROUP BY gender ORDER BY n_students DESC;

question_fa: در دیتاست عمومی، گروه‌های gender را از نظر افسردگی، اضطراب، حمایت اجتماعی و بهره‌وری رتبه‌بندی کن.
sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(AVG(depression_score), 2) AS avg_depression, ROUND(AVG(anxiety_score), 2) AS avg_anxiety, ROUND(AVG(social_support_score), 2) AS avg_social_support, ROUND(AVG(productivity_score), 2) AS avg_productivity, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(depression_score) DESC) AS rank_by_depression FROM mental_health_general GROUP BY gender ORDER BY rank_by_depression;

question_fa: در هر جنسیت، ۵ شهر با بیشترین نرخ افسردگی دانشجویان کدام‌اند؟
sql: WITH city_gender_rates AS (SELECT gender, city, COUNT(*) AS total, 100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*) AS depression_rate_pct FROM student_depression GROUP BY gender, city HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY depression_rate_pct DESC) AS rn FROM city_gender_rates) SELECT gender, city, total, ROUND(depression_rate_pct, 2) AS depression_rate_pct FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY gender, depression_rate_pct DESC;

question_fa: در محیط کار، ماتریس مزایا و گزینه‌های مراقبت را از نظر درمان‌جویی و پیامد منفی بساز.
sql: SELECT benefits, care_options, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(treatment) / COUNT(*), 2) AS treatment_rate_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(obs_consequence) / COUNT(*), 2) AS observed_consequence_rate_pct FROM workplace_mental_health_survey GROUP BY benefits, care_options HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY treatment_rate_pct DESC;

question_fa: در نظرسنجی دانشگاهی، gender را از نظر هم‌وقوعی افسردگی و اضطراب تحلیل کن.
sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN depression_diagnosis = 1 AND anxiety_diagnosis = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comorbid_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN depression_diagnosis = 1 AND anxiety_diagnosis = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS comorbid_rate_pct, SUM(treatment_seeking) AS treatment_count FROM university_student_mental_health GROUP BY gender ORDER BY comorbid_rate_pct DESC;

question_fa: در نظرسنجی محیط کار، کشورها را بر اساس نرخ مشاهده پیامد منفی رتبه‌بندی کن.
sql: WITH country_obs AS (SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS total, 100.0 * SUM(obs_consequence) / COUNT(*) AS obs_consequence_rate_pct FROM workplace_mental_health_survey WHERE country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10) SELECT country, total, ROUND(obs_consequence_rate_pct, 2) AS obs_consequence_rate_pct, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY obs_consequence_rate_pct DESC) AS rank_by_observed_consequence FROM country_obs ORDER BY rank_by_observed_consequence;

question_fa: توزیع سختی مرخصی گرفتن به دلیل سلامت روان را نشان بده.
sql: SELECT leave_difficulty, COUNT(*) AS count FROM workplace_mental_health_survey GROUP BY leave_difficulty ORDER BY count DESC;

question_fa: در دانشجویان افسردگی، ماتریس استرس مالی و فشار تحصیلی را از نظر نرخ افسردگی بساز.
sql: WITH binned AS (SELECT CASE WHEN financial_stress IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' WHEN financial_stress < 4 THEN '<4' WHEN financial_stress < 6 THEN '4-6' WHEN financial_stress < 8 THEN '6-8' ELSE '8+' END AS x_bucket, CASE WHEN academic_pressure IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' WHEN academic_pressure < 2 THEN '<2' WHEN academic_pressure < 4 THEN '2-4' ELSE '4+' END AS y_bucket, depression_flag, cgpa_10 FROM student_depression) SELECT x_bucket, y_bucket, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*), 2) AS depression_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(cgpa_10), 2) AS avg_cgpa_10 FROM binned GROUP BY x_bucket, y_bucket HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY x_bucket, y_bucket;

question_fa: میانگین افسردگی و بهره‌وری دیتاست عمومی به تفکیک سابقه سلامت روان چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT mental_health_history, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(AVG(depression_score), 2) AS avg_depression_score, ROUND(AVG(productivity_score), 2) AS avg_productivity_score FROM mental_health_general GROUP BY mental_health_history ORDER BY avg_depression_score DESC;

question_fa: درصد درمان‌جویی در نظرسنجی محیط کار به تفکیک کشور برای کشورهای با حداقل ۲۰ پاسخ‌دهنده چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(treatment) AS treatment_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(treatment) / COUNT(*), 2) AS treatment_rate_pct FROM workplace_mental_health_survey WHERE country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY treatment_rate_pct DESC;

question_fa: برای هر degree، شهری که بیشترین نرخ افسردگی داره رو پیدا کن.
sql: WITH dc AS (SELECT degree, city, COUNT(*) AS n, 100.0*SUM(depression_flag)/COUNT(*) AS rate FROM student_depression WHERE degree IS NOT NULL AND city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY degree, city HAVING COUNT(*)>=100), r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY degree ORDER BY rate DESC,n DESC) AS rn FROM dc) SELECT degree, city, n, ROUND(rate,2) AS depression_rate_pct FROM r WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY depression_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 20;

question_fa: برای شهرهای با نمونه کافی، فشار تحصیلی رو رتبه‌بندی کن - نسخه 28.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(cgpa_10) AS avg_cgpa, AVG(academic_pressure) AS avg_pressure FROM student_depression WHERE city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*)>=680) SELECT city, n, ROUND(avg_cgpa,2) AS avg_cgpa, ROUND(avg_pressure,2) AS avg_pressure, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_pressure DESC) AS pressure_rank FROM s ORDER BY pressure_rank LIMIT 12;

question_fa: در محیط کار، ماتریس حمایت همکاران و سرپرست را از نظر درمان‌جویی و پیامد منفی بساز.
sql: SELECT coworkers, supervisor, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(treatment) / COUNT(*), 2) AS treatment_rate_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(obs_consequence) / COUNT(*), 2) AS observed_consequence_rate_pct FROM workplace_mental_health_survey GROUP BY coworkers, supervisor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY treatment_rate_pct DESC;

question_fa: نمای یکپارچه افراد به تفکیک منبع چه میانگین سنی و تعداد رکوردی دارد؟
sql: SELECT source_name, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(AVG(age), 2) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN depression_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS depression_flag_count, SUM(CASE WHEN treatment_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS treatment_flag_count FROM vw_unified_individual_mental_health GROUP BY source_name ORDER BY total DESC;

question_fa: در دیتاست دانشجویان افسردگی، degree را از نظر نرخ افسردگی و فشار تحصیلی رتبه‌بندی کن.
sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT degree, COUNT(*) AS total, 100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*) AS depression_rate_pct, AVG(academic_pressure) AS avg_academic_pressure, AVG(cgpa_10) AS avg_cgpa FROM student_depression GROUP BY degree HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) SELECT degree, total, ROUND(depression_rate_pct, 2) AS depression_rate_pct, ROUND(avg_academic_pressure, 2) AS avg_academic_pressure, ROUND(avg_cgpa, 2) AS avg_cgpa_10, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY depression_rate_pct DESC) AS rank_by_depression_rate FROM grouped ORDER BY rank_by_depression_rate;

question_fa: میانگین سن در دیتاست سلامت روان عمومی چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(age), 2) AS avg_age FROM mental_health_general WHERE age IS NOT NULL;

question_fa: داشبورد اولویت مداخله دانشجویان افسردگی بر اساس رژیم غذایی را بساز.
sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT dietary_habits, COUNT(*) AS total, 100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*) AS depression_rate_pct, 100.0 * SUM(suicidal_thoughts) / COUNT(*) AS suicidal_rate_pct, AVG(academic_pressure) AS avg_academic_pressure, AVG(cgpa_10) AS avg_cgpa FROM student_depression GROUP BY dietary_habits), scored AS (SELECT *, depression_rate_pct * 0.40 + suicidal_rate_pct * 0.35 + avg_academic_pressure * 10 * 0.25 AS intervention_priority_score FROM grouped) SELECT dietary_habits, total, ROUND(depression_rate_pct, 2) AS depression_rate_pct, ROUND(suicidal_rate_pct, 2) AS suicidal_rate_pct, ROUND(avg_academic_pressure, 2) AS avg_academic_pressure, ROUND(avg_cgpa, 2) AS avg_cgpa_10, ROUND(intervention_priority_score, 2) AS intervention_priority_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY intervention_priority_score DESC) AS priority_rank FROM scored ORDER BY priority_rank;

question_fa: برای دیتاست عمومی، threshold استرس نسخه 32 رو با ریسک و بهره‌وری ترکیب کن.
sql: WITH b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN stress_level>4 THEN 'stress_above_threshold' ELSE 'stress_below_threshold' END AS stress_segment, mental_health_risk, productivity_score, sleep_hours FROM mental_health_general WHERE stress_level IS NOT NULL) SELECT 32 AS scenario_id, stress_segment, mental_health_risk, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(productivity_score),2) AS avg_productivity, ROUND(AVG(sleep_hours),2) AS avg_sleep FROM b GROUP BY stress_segment, mental_health_risk ORDER BY stress_segment, n DESC;

question_fa: توی داده جهانی، چند کشور یا منطقه داریم؟
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country_name) AS n_locations_global FROM country_prevalence_long;

question_fa: روند شیوع افسردگی، اضطراب و اختلال دوقطبی در Australia را در طول زمان مقایسه کن.
sql: SELECT year, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'depression' THEN prevalence_pct END), 3) AS depression_pct, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'anxiety' THEN prevalence_pct END), 3) AS anxiety_pct, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN disorder = 'bipolar' THEN prevalence_pct END), 3) AS bipolar_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE country_name = 'Australia' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question_fa: داشبورد شکاف بهره‌وری دیتاست عمومی بر اساس ریسک سلامت روان را بساز.
sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(productivity_score) AS overall_productivity, AVG(depression_score) AS overall_depression FROM mental_health_general), grouped AS (SELECT mental_health_risk, COUNT(*) AS total, AVG(productivity_score) AS avg_productivity, AVG(depression_score) AS avg_depression, AVG(anxiety_score) AS avg_anxiety, SUM(CASE WHEN mental_health_risk='High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_risk_count FROM mental_health_general GROUP BY mental_health_risk) SELECT mental_health_risk, total, ROUND(avg_productivity, 2) AS avg_productivity, ROUND(avg_productivity - overall_productivity, 2) AS productivity_gap, ROUND(avg_depression, 2) AS avg_depression, ROUND(avg_depression - overall_depression, 2) AS depression_gap, ROUND(avg_anxiety, 2) AS avg_anxiety, ROUND(100.0 * high_risk_count / total, 2) AS high_risk_rate_pct FROM grouped CROSS JOIN overall ORDER BY productivity_gap ASC;

question_fa: میانگین شیوع جهانی bipolar به تفکیک سال چیست؟
sql: SELECT year, ROUND(AVG(prevalence_pct), 3) AS avg_bipolar_prevalence_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE disorder = 'bipolar' AND is_country_like = 1 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question_fa: برای هر اختلال، کشور با بیشترین شیوع در آخرین سال کدام است؟
sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT * FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE is_country_like = 1 AND year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long)), ranked AS (SELECT disorder, country_name, prevalence_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY disorder ORDER BY prevalence_pct DESC) AS rn FROM latest) SELECT disorder, country_name, ROUND(prevalence_pct, 3) AS prevalence_pct FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY prevalence_pct DESC;

question_fa: توزیع سابقه خانوادگی در نظرسنجی محیط کار را نشان بده.
sql: SELECT family_history, COUNT(*) AS count FROM workplace_mental_health_survey GROUP BY family_history ORDER BY count DESC;

question_fa: تعداد کل رکوردهای دانشجویان چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_records FROM student_depression;

question_fa: تعداد کل افراد شرکت کننده در نظرسنجی محیط کار چند نفر است؟
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_participants FROM workplace_mental_health_survey;

question_fa: میانگین کلی نمره اضطراب همه افراد چقدر است؟
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(anxiety_score), 2) AS avg_anxiety FROM mental_health_general WHERE anxiety_score IS NOT NULL;

question_fa: میانگین فشار تحصیلی دانشجویان را به تفکیک کیفیت خواب نشان بده.
sql: SELECT sleep_quality, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(academic_pressure), 2) AS avg_academic_pressure FROM student_depression WHERE sleep_quality IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sleep_quality ORDER BY avg_academic_pressure DESC;

question_fa: در کل، چه تعداد از افراد افسردگی دارند؟
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS depressed_count FROM student_depression WHERE depression_flag = 1;

question_fa: توزیع کیفیت رژیم غذایی در میان همه دانشجویان چگونه است؟
sql: SELECT dietary_habits, COUNT(*) AS n_students FROM student_depression GROUP BY dietary_habits ORDER BY n_students DESC;
